subject: Control translation & evidence rally for CSA submission
messages:
From: Seth Park <seth@advisorcorp.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@advisorcorp.com
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CSA submission — control-level evidence ask

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our security team is packaging a CSA/CAIQ submission for our procurement committee and needs two things from Redwood: a control-level translation (CSA control -> Redwood internal control / artifact) and a short set of representative evidence files for a pre-procurement review.

Specifically:
- Map the CSA control IDs we discussed to the specific artifacts you can provide (logs, configs, attestation).
- Provide a short sample of runtime logs and a contact list of owners for each mapped control.
- Confirm whether any evidence will require redaction or a data-sharing agreement before we can accept files.

Can you confirm next steps and whether you can deliver a short package by end-of-week (Friday 10/22)? Our procurement deadline is the week after.

Thanks —
Seth
Senior Security Program Manager
AdvisorCorp
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Seth Park <seth@advisorcorp.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CSA submission — control-level evidence ask

Seth — thanks, we can do that. Quick plan below and an initial artifact we can attach.

Plan (high level):
1) Control translation workbook — map CSA control -> Redwood control / artifact / owner (attached as redwood_csa_control_translation_v0.1.xlsx).
2) Representative evidence bundle — selective runtime logs, config snapshots, and procedural docs (we will not include customer PII).
3) Owner roster + delivery timeline — owners cc'd here will confirm samples and handoff windows.

Immediate asks for you:
- Confirm scope: do you need the full control set or only the controls in the procurement checklist we reviewed? If only the checklist, send the control IDs.
- Any required redaction/localization constraints (EU-only artifacts, etc.)?

Owners and commitments:
- Jonas Weber: runtime logs / telemetry samples (will produce a sampled tarball).
- Marissa Cole: artifact index and narrative mapping for each control.
- Diego Fernandez: infrastructure config snapshots and KMS attestation notes.

Deliverable target: draft package to be uploaded to the Drive link below by 2026-10-22 EOD. If procurement needs signed NDA before we upload artifacts, let us know — we can stage everything behind a temporary link.

Attachments: redwood_csa_control_translation_v0.1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

Drive (working folder): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwoodCSA

—
Mina Haddad
Head of Compliance Programs

Quick note on logs: I will produce a sampled KV/cache runtime log bundle that demonstrates control behavior for session isolation and key eviction. Two clarifications for Seth:
- We will strip all customer identifiers, but the sample will retain request/response timing and anonymized request ids.
- The sample will reflect a 72-hour window; if you need a different window, tell me which dates.

Planned attachment: runtime_log_sample.tgz (sanitized) — ETA 10/19 10:00am PT.

Seth / Mina — putting together the evidence roster. Below is a concise mapping we will include in the package; the control IDs in column A map to artifact examples in column B. This is a summary — the full workbook has narrative justifications.

- CCM-G.1.1 (Identity & Access) -> IAM policy export + role-binding snapshot (artifact: iam_roles_202610.tgz)
- CCM-SS.3.4 (Logging) -> runtime_log_sample.tgz (sanitized telemetry)
- CCM-CR.2.2 (Key Management) -> KMS attestation notes + key-rotation SOP (artifact: kms_rotation_2026.pdf)
- CCM-SD.1.5 (Data Residency) -> network ACL and VPC peering diagram (artifact: vpc_diagram.png)

Owners and point people for the bundle:
- IAM & roles: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.com)
- Runtime logs: Jonas Weber (jonas_weber@redwood.com)
- KMS & crypto: Diego Fernandez (diego_fernandez@redwood.com)

Timeline:
- 10/19 AM: runtime_log_sample.tgz uploaded to Drive (sanitized).
- 10/19 PM: evidence_roster_v1.csv and narrative snippets uploaded.
- 10/22 EOD: completed draft package for AdvisorCorp review.

Notes on redaction / governance: we will not share private customer payloads. Anything that requires vendor-signed NDA will be flagged in the roster and we can provide ephemeral access to sandboxed artifacts.

Attachments referenced: evidence_roster_v1.csv
HubSpot ticket: HUBSPOT-12345
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwoodCSA

Marissa, Mina — this looks good, thanks. A couple quick items:
- Procurement will need a short cover note explaining the sanitization steps (can you include a 1-paragraph statement when you upload?).
- We will accept the Drive folder link for now, but procurement reserves the right to request an SFTP or signed transfer if the docs contain anything marked sensitive.

If you can get the draft by EOD 10/22 that is perfect — we will escalate to legal if procurement asks for a formal NDA.

I'll reply here if procurement needs anything else.
